description:
Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

opencodex is a universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Grok Build: a local proxy that lets them run on many different LLM providers from a single port, translating between API wire formats.

Features:
- Works with Anthropic, Google, xAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Azure, DeepSeek, Ollama, and 40+ other built-in providers.
- Supports streaming, tool calls, reasoning, and images.
- Handles OAuth logins and a ChatGPT account pool.
- Native model picker in the Codex app, sub-agents, and search/vision sidecars.
Published to npm as @bitkyc08/opencodex@2.100.10 with dist-tag latest.
New Features
- Follow Codex GPT-Live defaults and gpt-transcribe fields (#9139)
- RunAPI Standard sponsor preset, README row and docs (#9047)
- Relay public GPT-Live sessions for API-key providers (#9142)
- Opt the legacy opencodex provider table into Cyber access programs (#9144)
Bug Fixes
- Align live scope checks between the native and external paths (#9141)
- Codex 5505daf388 passthrough parity (stream exclusions, advertised WS limit) (#9140)
Other Changes
- Refresh provider model catalogs against vendor sources (Gemini, Copilot, GLM-5.4, qwen4-max, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Cursor) (#9143)
